Name: Gifts from Emily - Spiritual Vibes and Handmade Styles
Author: LoganDoidao989
Description:
[center][color=#AAAAAA][size=6]Gifts From Emily – Spiritual Vibes and Handmade Styles 💎✨🧵🌈[/size][/color][/center]
[center][/center]
[center][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/46196/46196-1778707570-1168637075.png[/img][/center]
[center][color=#AAAAAA]
Become closer to Emily and receive warm letters filled with positive energy, colorful surprises, handmade materials, spiritual treasures, and thoughtful gifts delivered directly to your mailbox! 💌🌿
As your friendship grows, Emily shares pieces of her unique world through crystals, fabrics, flowers, food, mystical items, and cozy sewing supplies. Every heart level unlocks new immersive mail events designed to feel natural, rewarding, and full of personality. ✨🪡💜
This mod adds progression-based friendship rewards through Mail Framework Mod, including extra sewing-themed letters after unlocking Emily’s sewing machine event. 🧶👗[/color]

[line]
[/center]
[center][b][size=4]It's time to get some love back! 🎁✨[/size][/b]

Let's be honest: you spend days chasing villagers around town, memorizing their bizarre schedules,
and spending a fortune on rare items just to get... silence? Or maybe a recipe you'll never actually make. 🙄
[b][size=4]Those one-sided days are over![/size][/b]
All the dedication, effort, and hard-earned cash spent building a friendship now come right back to you.
With this mod, camaraderie is a two-way street: receive unique letters and gifts at every friendship level,and the rewards get better with every single heart you earn! ❤️📈

[b][size=4]Finally, making new friends is completely worth it! 🤝💥[/size][/b]

Enjoy the basic perks early on and get ready to be surprised by advanced loot as your bond deepens.
From common stones found on the ground to precious relics and survival tools...
after all, every character has their own unique taste (and level of sanity)! 💎
[i]Clear out your mailbox, prepare your inventory space, and start enjoying the return on your investment![/i] 😉🎒

[color=#ffffff]────────────────────────────────────
[size=5][b]⚙️ → Installation ← ⚙️[/b][/size][/color]

[b]1. [/b]⬇️ Download the mod from [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley]Nexus Mods[/url] (the only place I upload—if you found it elsewhere, run 🏃). 
[b]2.[/b] 📦 Drop the ZIP file into your Stardew Valley [i]Mods[/i] folder. 
[b]3.[/b] 🧠 Extract it there like a civilized human being. 
[b]4. [/b]🚀 Launch the game using SMAPI. 
[b]5. [/b]🎉 Enjoy your new social life![/color]

[color=#ffffff]────────────────────────────────────[/color]

[color=#ffffff][size=5][b]🗑️ → Uninstall ← 🗑️[/b][/size][/color]

[color=#ffffff][b]1.[/b] 🧹 Delete the mod folder from your [i]Mods[/i] directory.
[b]2.[/b] 💔 Go back to Nexus Mods and tell me why you left me (optional, but emotionally impactful). 
[b]3.[/b] 😢 I’ll pretend I’m fine. 
[b]4. [/b]🌾 Go enjoy Stardew Valley without me… I guess.[/color]

[color=#ffffff]────────────────────────────────────[/color]

[color=#ffffff][size=5][b]🔄 → Update ← 🔄[/b][/size][/color]

[color=#ffffff]1.❗ Delete the old version (yes, really—don’t be lazy).
2. 📥 Install the new version following the steps above.[/color]

[color=#ffffff][b]⚠️ Important:[/b]
 Do [b]NOT[/b] overwrite files. That’s how chaos begins 💀
 Delete first, then install the update like a responsible adult.[/color]
